name: 2040 aluminum extrusion
summary: 20 × 40 mm framing profile. Six 6 mm slots, two central bores; length can be edited.
description: A wider 2020 profile for printer bases, bed rails and gantries. Two slots run along each wide face and one along each narrow face. Uses 20-series T-nuts.
source: MISUMI HFS5-2040: nominal 20 × 40 mm section, 6 mm openings, two slots on each wide face and one on each narrow face. Internal cavities and the two 4.2 mm bores are simplified; this is an approximate generic profile, not the complete MISUMI die section.
